changeSet.author: savdocrm-catalog
changeSet.comment: Seed the 8 standard system-defined units of measure for all existing tenants idempotently
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO units_of_measure ( id, tenant_id, code, name, symbol, allow_decimal, decimal_precision, is_system, is_active, created_at, updated_at, version ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), t.id, v.code, v.name, v.symbol, v.allow_decimal, v.decimal_precision, true, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 FROM tenants t CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('PCS', 'Piece', 'pcs', false, 0), ('KG', 'Kilogram', 'kg', true, 3), ('G', 'Gram', 'g', false, 0), ('L', 'Liter', 'l', true, 3), ('ML', 'Milliliter', 'ml', false, 0), ('M', 'Meter', 'm', true, 2), ('BOX', 'Box', 'box', false, 0), ('PACK', 'Package', 'pack', false, 0) ) AS v(code, name, symbol, allow_decimal, decimal_precision) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM units_of_measure u WHERE u.tenant_id = t.id AND u.code = v.code );
